_comment: Plays before every run after the first, on a dark confessional. The voice has no name plate; in the true ending it turns out to be Father Eli. It asks where to begin, and the player, as the priest behind the grille, answers: that answer picks the starting story and so the timeline. 'last_line' is the voice taking up the answer; 'more' is what the voice says after any ending but the true one. See docs/STORY_BIBLE.md, section 6.

lines.text: Basbasan n'yo po ako, Padre, dahil nagkasala ako.
Matagal na po mula nung huli akong nangumpisal.
Hindi ko po alam kung saan magsisimula.

tokhang.text: Sa palengke po. Isang hapon na parang wala lang.

kumpisal.text: Sa simbahan po. Isang Sabado ng hapon.

padala.text: Sa kwarto po. Sa likod ng pintong nakakandado.

more.text: Hindi pa po iyon ang buong kumpisal, Padre.
